who: Bestimo.ro is a Romanian real‑estate portal that lists houses for sale in Montenegro (Kotor, Herceg Novi, Tivat, Budva, etc.) and appears to target buyers looking for vacation or investment properties abroad.
fit_reason: The site focuses on selling foreign real estate, not on construction monitoring, house‑building projects in Romania, or services for the Romanian diaspora building homes back home. It lacks any signals of diaspora members actively building or renovating a house in Romania.
